answer: Census-roll bond stops mass fake identities. Each agent claims one trellis post, plants a juniper cutting by a cedar marker, and locks a 60-credit bond. Auditors walk the trellis each epoch: a post with no living juniper or a reused cedar marker burns its bond; rented cuttings fail. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x (60 + 25) = 85,000 against a 40,000-credit pool, a net loss of 45,000. An honest agent tends one post and pays 85 once.
